## Proposal

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Use Case / Real-World Context

Explain the real-world scenario where this feature would be useful. Which domain does it apply to (game dev, networking, UI, etc.)?

## Suggested Solution

Describe how you envision this being implemented. If you have C++ code examples, include them here.

## Alternative Approaches Considered

Have you considered other ways to solve this? Why is this approach better?

## Pattern Category

- [ ] Creational
- [ ] Structural
- [ ] Behavioral
- [ ] General Application Feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Tooling / CI/CD

## Additional Context

Add any other context, mockups, or references here.
